title: Rythu Bharosa Money Calculator for Small Farmers
title_te: చిన్న రైతుల కోసం రైతు భరోసా డబ్బు లెక్కింపు
problem: Small farmers get confused calculating government support money based on their exact guntha land size. They depend on brokers who charge fees.
idea: A calculator where a farmer enters land in acres and guntas and the support amount per acre. It shows the money for one season and the whole year. No broker needed!

widgets.heading: 🧮 Try it: How much support for my land?
widgets.intro: 1 acre = 40 guntas. The amount per acre can change, so type the latest amount from the Agriculture Office or official website.
widgets.formula: if (acres < 0 || guntas < 0 || guntas > 39 || perAcre <= 0) return null; var land = acres + guntas / 40; var s = land * perAcre; return {land: land, season: Math.round(s), year: Math.round(s * Number(seasons)), level: 'good'};

widgets.heading: 📝 How to check and get your support money

items.title: Keep papers ready
items.text: Pattadar passbook, Aadhaar card and bank passbook.
items.te: పట్టాదార్ పాస్‌బుక్, ఆధార్, బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ సిద్ధంగా ఉంచండి.

items.title: Meet the AEO
items.text: Visit the Agriculture Extension Officer at Rythu Vedika to check your name is in the list.
items.te: రైతు వేదికలో వ్యవసాయ విస్తరణ అధికారిని కలిసి మీ పేరు జాబితాలో ఉందో చూడండి.

items.title: Bank and Aadhaar
items.text: Make sure your bank account is active and linked to Aadhaar.
items.te: మీ బ్యాంక్ ఖాతా ఆధార్‌తో లింక్ అయి ఉండాలి.

items.title: Check SMS / passbook
items.text: Money comes straight to the bank. Update your passbook to see it.
items.te: డబ్బు నేరుగా బ్యాంక్‌లో పడుతుంది. పాస్‌బుక్ అప్‌డేట్ చేయించండి.

items.title: No broker fees
items.text: This is a free government scheme. Nobody should take money to 'help'.
items.te: ఇది ఉచిత ప్రభుత్వ పథకం. ఎవరికీ డబ్బు ఇవ్వవద్దు.

questions.q: How many guntas make one acre?
questions.why: 1 acre = 40 guntas. So 20 guntas = half an acre.

questions.q: A man asks ₹500 to 'get your Rythu Bharosa money'. What do you do?
options: Refuse and go to the AEO / Rythu Vedika
questions.why: The scheme is free. Go to the official office.

questions.q: Where does the support money go?
questions.why: Government support goes directly to the farmer's bank account.

how: Ask the Agriculture Officer or check the official website for the latest amount per acre.
Use Gemini to make 5 example sums: e.g. 1 acre 10 guntas, 3 acres 25 guntas.
In Scratch, make 3 'ask' blocks: acres, guntas, amount per acre.
Set land = acres + guntas ÷ 40, then money = land × amount. Make the cat say the answer.
Check the Scratch answers with Gemini's example sums.
Make a step-by-step poster in Canva and put it up at the Gram Panchayat.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in Telangana. Explain in simple English and Telugu how to calculate a farmer's Rythu Bharosa support when land is given in acres and guntas (1 acre = 40 guntas). Use ₹6,000 per acre per season only as an example, show 3 worked examples, and remind farmers to confirm the latest amount at the Agriculture Office and never pay brokers.
